stem: Which statement about the number 510 is true?

options.label: A
options.text: It is odd, because it can be divided by 3 evenly.

options.label: B
options.text: It is odd, because the digit in the hundreds place is odd.

options.label: C
options.text: It is even, because it can be divided by 2 evenly.

options.label: D
options.text: It is even, because the digit in the tens place is even.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding of odd/even rules about divisibility and place value, a direct recall and application of these basic concepts.
